page.content:
Shadaloo dictator who rules through Psycho Power.

How M. Bison connects

  • Faction: Shadaloo — M. Bison rules Shadaloo through Psycho Power.
  • Concept: Psycho Power — M. Bison rules and body-hops through Psycho Power.
  • Work: Street Fighter II — Street Fighter II ends with M. Bison as Shadaloo's final boss.
  • Character: Guile — Guile hunts M. Bison for Charlie Nash's death.

What is M. Bison?

M. Bison is the dictator of Shadaloo, a body-hopping tyrant whose Psycho Power made him the final boss of Street Fighter II and the long-running enemy of Chun-Li, Guile, and Cammy.

Key threads lead to Shadaloo, Psycho Power, Street Fighter II and Guile.
